canonical_project: Four hyperscale data centres in Assam (Government of India plan)
owner: Government of India (DoT/MeitY initiative; no operator named)
notes: Union Telecom Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia announced at Advantage Assam 2.0 (25 Feb 2025) that the Centre plans Asia's four largest hyperscale data centres in Assam (~1 million sq ft total), alongside 5G expansion and Rs 400 crore state telecom/IT investment. Statewide plan with no specific site/developer; attributed to Guwahati (Kamrup Metropolitan) as hub. Policy announcement only - do not count as pipeline capacity without named investor/site. Grade B.
